text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — TideWorks (preview cohort) showing a noticeable dip in tokens/day and active seats over the last 72h. Renewal outreach is due in ~3 weeks, want to triage now before we escalate.

sam_se: looked through infra logs quickly. Noted a ~4x increase in prefix cache misses and a small spike in p95 latency after their front-end push. Query I ran: ```SELECT customer, bucket, sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE customer='tideworks' AND ts > now()-interval '72 hours' GROUP BY 1,2;```

nina_pm: thanks — product saw a UI change rolled by their web team yesterday (they called out a template refactor). I'm locking a hotfix branch now and can roll a targeted canary tomorrow morning.

devon_onboard: they missed the enablement workshop last week and haven't RSVP'd to the make-up. I can run a hands-on session Wed 10:00am PT if that works for everyone. I'll invite their eng lead + product owner.

maria_cs: please add this agenda for Wed: quick streaming walkthrough, prefix/KV cache tips, token dashboard walkthrough, and a 15m plan for failover to lighter model. Also include a short prework checklist for their engs. Link to current usage: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/tideworks/usage

ops-bot: Deploybot: scheduled job preview-fix/tideworks-canary -> deploy at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z (canary, 10% cohort routing).

ollie_csm: +1 to proactive outreach. Suggested immediate mitigation steps: 1) enable prefix cache on their primary route, 2) temporarily bump burst quota for 24h, 3) configure automatic fallback to model-variant-small if latency > 350ms for >5m.

sam_se: I can run the cache warmup script and apply the fallback rule. Need their route id and one API key with test scope. Quick snippet I'll run: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/<route-id>/actions/warm_cache -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'```

maria_cs: shared route-id+test key via DM to @sam_se. Also attaching a brief excerpt from their support ticket: "responses are shorter and inconsistent post-deploy, sometimes empty lines between chunks".

nina_pm: I'll monitor canary KPIs for the next 6 hours after deploy: latency_p95, tokens_per_day, cache_hit_rate, errors/1m. If cache_hit_rate improves by >20% and tokens/day recovers, we keep. If not, rollback and schedule extended enablement.

maria_cs: action items recap: Devon = run Wed 10am PT enablement + invite; Sam = apply cache warmup + fallback by next deploy; Nina = canary monitor & decide keep/rollback; Ollie = draft renewal outreach (tone: supportive, timeline + next steps). I'll draft the outreach after we see canary signals, aiming for 48h post-fix. Please ack.

devon_onboard: ack — will create calendar + prework doc.

sam_se: ack, starting warmup playbook now.

nina_pm: ack, setting alerts on the canary dashboard.

maria_cs: thanks team :rocket: — I'll ping TideWorks and block Wed 10am PT on their calendar once Devon shares invite. If anyone needs direct context, DMed the support excerpt.

ollie_csm: added a one-pager to the thread: checklist for renewal messaging (support timeline, canary outcomes, usage tips). Will post after Devon's invite is live. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: closing loop here unless something new pops up. Will update thread after canary results.
